components.css: .ds-time { --ink: #153d28; --muted: #405c35; --green: #173f29; --green-hover: #0e3020; --surface: #fff; --line: #d7e3ce; --soft: #e2efc3; --focus: #245c35; --energy: #d4f458; --canvas: #edf5d5; }.ds-time { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer;display: block; position: relative; cursor: pointer; }.ds-time input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; width: 1px; height: 1px; }.ds-time span { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 56px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); font-size: .9375rem; color: var(--muted); }.ds-time input:checked + span { background: var(--green); border-color: var(--green); color: #fff; font-weight: 600; }.ds-time:has(input:focus-visible) { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 4px; border-radius: 12px; }

narrative.overview:
The existing phone-first exercise interface has an energetic lime morning atmosphere. Deep forest text and controls keep the screen legible outdoors; the solid white routine group provides a stable reading surface. Preserve the familiar single-column composition, direct language, workout content and immediate path from opening the app to starting a workout.

Three large, cropped CSS shapes move slowly behind the interface. Their motion is peripheral and settles as soon as a workout begins, including while that workout is paused. The backdrop remains CSS geometry. Small pixel-art movement demos supply practical guidance in the foreground.
keyCharacteristics: Bright lime atmosphere with forest-green functional contrast.
One solid white routine group and one clear primary action.
Familiar system typography with a heavier workout heading.
Slow geometric background motion that yields to exercising and user preferences.

rules.name: The Readable Foreground Rule
rules.body: Keep routine content on its opaque white surface and functional text in the forest palette; the moving scene stays behind the interface.

rules.name: The Immediate Start Rule
rules.body: The default screen remains the workout overview with its Start action. Background controls must not add an introductory step.

rules.name: The Exercise Stillness Rule
rules.body: Start settles the decorative background for the entire active workout; pausing the workout never restarts the background.

dos: **Do** keep lime energy behind a solid, legible routine group.
**Do** preserve the existing content, system typography, single-column structure and direct Start path.
**Do** keep background motion slow, bounded and transform-only.
**Do** honor manual pause, hidden tabs and live Reduce Motion changes.
**Do** retain visible keyboard focus, generous tap targets and readable safety instructions.
donts: **Don't** run decorative background motion during an active or paused workout.
**Don't** add onboarding or another step before the workout overview.
**Don't** replace the CSS geometry with raster assets or extra animated layers.
**Don't** turn the routine into separate floating movement cards or add shadows to the flat surface system.
